name: F370CR · F190CR
summary: Composite-ready office FDM for strong carbon-fibre-filled parts.

page.description: Stratasys F370CR · F190CR 3D printer from IME Additive Manufacturing, Malaysia: specifications, applications and pricing.
page.headline: Affordable carbon-fibre
page.lead: Composite-ready F123 printers for carbon-fibre ABS and nylon, so strong, light jigs, fixtures and tooling can replace machined metal parts.
page.footnote: * or ±0.002 mm/mm, whichever is greater; Z adds ±1 layer height. Source: stratasys.com F370CR and F190CR pages, read 10 Nov 2026.

features.title: Carbon-fibre materials
features.text: ABS-CF10 and FDM Nylon-CF10; the F370CR adds FDM Nylon 12CF.

features.title: Up to four layer resolutions
features.text: Choose detail or speed per job.

features.title: Soluble support
features.text: Complex geometry without manual support removal.

benefits.title: Strength
benefits.text: Stratasys says Nylon-CF10 is 67 % stronger and 190 % stiffer than its base nylon.

benefits.title: Cost effective
benefits.text: Composite and non-composite materials on one printer.

benefits.title: Small footprint
benefits.text: Fits a classroom, office or shop.

specs.label: Material bays
specs.value: F370CR: 2 model + 2 support · F190CR: 1 model + 1 support

specs.label: Accuracy
specs.value: ±0.200 mm or ±0.002 mm/mm, whichever is greater; Z adds ±1 layer height

specs.label: Materials
specs.value: F370CR: FDM Nylon 12CF, FDM Nylon-CF10, ABS-CF10, ASA, ABS-M30, PC-ABS, ABS-ESD7, Diran 410MF07, TPU 92A · F190CR: FDM Nylon-CF10, ABS-CF10, ASA, ABS-M30, TPU 92A

specs.label: Software
specs.value: GrabCAD Print, GrabCAD Print Pro, Insight (F370CR); MTConnect enabled

specs.label: Network
specs.value: Wired 100BASE-T Ethernet (TCP/IP), RJ45; wireless-ready IEEE 802.11 b/g/n; WPA2-PSK and 802.1x EAP

specs.label: Compliance
specs.value: CE (low-voltage and EMC), FCC, EAC, cTUVus, KC, RoHS, WEEE, REACH, RCM

page.applications_heading: Strong, light tools that replace machined metal.
page.applications_text: Workholding, end-of-arm tools and functional prototypes in carbon-fibre composites.

applications.title: Jigs and fixtures
applications.text: Strong, lightweight polymer tools in place of metal.
